source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 26. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: The du'aa for leaving home, walking well, and greeting others

learn.en: When you leave home, say the du'aa the Prophet ﷺ taught us.
learn.title: Leaving home
learn.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
learn.tr: Bismi-llāh, tawakkaltu ʿala-llāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh

learn.en: Walk with ease — not too fast, not too slow — like the Prophet ﷺ.
learn.title: Walk with ease

learn.en: If you see something harmful on the path, move it aside. A man was forgiven for moving a thorny plant from the road!
learn.title: Clear the path

learn.en: Greet with As-salamu alaykum: the young greet the old first, and the one walking greets the one sitting.
learn.title: Greeting others

learn.en: When you come home, say As-salamu alaykum to your family.
learn.title: Coming home

words.en: Leaving home: In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah

quiz.en: You see broken glass on the path. What do you do?
opts: Move it aside safely or tell an adult

quiz.en: True or false? We should walk very fast and push past people.

think.q: Is there something small blocking a path near your home that you could move aside today?
think.a: Moving harm from the road is a real good deed!

parents.summary: Going out: the du'aa for leaving home, walking calmly, removing harm from the road, and greeting with salām.
parents.tip: Say the leaving-home du'aa together at the door every morning.
